translation.title: Terbinafine Hydrochloride Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes - tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea cruris (jock itch) and tinea corporis (ringworm of the body) - as well as pityriasis versicolor and cutaneous candidiasis.
translation.usage: Apply to the affected area 1 to 2 times a day. The treatment period depends on the condition: tinea pedis (athlete's foot) once a day for 1 week; interdigital (between-the-toes) tinea pedis twice a day for 1 week; plantar (sole) tinea pedis twice a day for 2 weeks; tinea corporis and tinea cruris 1 to 2 weeks; cutaneous candidiasis 1 to 2 weeks; pityriasis versicolor 2 weeks. Before use, wash the affected area clean and dry it completely, then spread a thin layer over the area 1 to 2 times a day, rubbing it in gently. Especially at night, for infections in skin folds (under the breasts, between the fingers or toes, between the buttocks, in the groin), the applied area may be covered with a piece of gauze.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, or for children. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have skin lesions that may be irritated by alcohol. Do not use an occlusive (airtight) dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor. Do not use acidic soap for candidiasis. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it in the eyes (on the cornea or conjunctiva); if it gets into the eyes, rinse them completely with plenty of water. Do not use it on the nails, scalp, around the mouth, on the vaginal area, or on cracked or eroded (raw) skin. Adverse reactions may occur - hypersensitivity reactions, rarely eye irritation, commonly skin peeling and itching, uncommonly skin lesions, scabs, skin disorders, pigmentation changes, erythema (red patches) and a burning sensation of the skin, rarely dry skin, contact dermatitis, eczema and rash, and uncommonly pain, pain or irritation at the application site; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
